newsitem.title: USA: U.S West Coast crude prices off amid idle markets.
newsitem.headline: U.S West Coast crude prices off amid idle markets.

text.p: U.S. West Coast light crude prices fell with spot markets on Monday, while local trade extended last week's quiet sessions, traders said.
Outright prices for Alaska North Slope (ANS) crude fell 14 cents a barrel to $17.89/18.04 a barrel Monday, but the local ANS differentials held at $1.97 under WTI for the second straight week.
Kern River and Wilmington grades were flat Monday after rising with postings the day before.
